class: regular numbered batch: new spatial-representation hypothesis for full-depth HIGH (within-patch continuous / higher-order / adaptive spatial representation); not a WL114 evidence-gap follow-up because it tests a new representation mechanism
title: Full-depth spatial HIGH representation and SSS correctness closure
machine: local RTX 5080 16 GB (WDDM); external/8dna26/.venv-cu128 (Python 3.11, Mitsuba 3.5.1, Dr.Jit 0.4.6, torch cu128)
preserved: WL112 / WL113 / WL114 verdicts (WL114 H1 INCONCLUSIVE, Mandatory SSS Gate NOT_RESOLVED), checkpoints (B1 / B2 experimental baselines, not adopted), results, references and the WL114 qualified full-depth SSS target (camera events 3..24, K* = 24). LR3: no implementation or training in this batch.
invariants: ER / material / medium unchanged (ER-v1-SDM candidate status unchanged); physical LOW = camera events 1-2; learned HIGH begins at camera event 3, read at event 2; source-independent response with linear source application; geometry-conditioned reuse; camera-independent transport state; contact-valid (C) semantics; approved 3 % SSS gate unchanged; no clamping, masking, denoising, energy compensation or finite-depth cancellation. Changed ONLY: HIGH within-patch spatial representation, its projection / reconstruction, minimum geometric descriptors / generator adaptations to express the selected basis, its physical targets, experiment-local training / readout, evaluation and profiling.
event_semantics: unchanged from WL114: HIGH_full = camera events 3..24 (probe f2 + fh + c7_12 + c13_24); reference FULL = e1 + e2 + h + c7_12 + c13_24 of the WL114 deep physical pass

evidence_classes.SELECTION: F0-F3 and sequences SEQ_A_lift, SEQ_B_slide, SEQ_C_independent (all WL114 views): the only configurations used for Stage A attribution and Stage B selection / calibration
evidence_classes.HELD_SEEN: F4, N1-N4, SEQ_D_independent: evaluated in WL114, never used for any WL115 selection, descriptor or calibration decision
evidence_classes.FRESH: N5-N8 and SEQ_E_fresh (common115: boxes / light from the D112 sampling rule with seed family 11515000; supports N5 (1.00, 0.50) contact on a floor-patch corner, N6 (0.625, 0.375) contact at a patch centre, N7 (1.20, 0.30) gap 8 mm, N8 (0.80, 0.55) gap 45 mm; SEQ_E: (0.62,0.30) c -> (0.70,0.30) c -> (0.78,0.30) c [crosses floor-patch boundary x = 0.75] -> gaps 5, 20, 70 mm -> (0.78,0.30) c [revisit of state 2] -> (0.62,0.30) c [revisit of state 0], views W0 / W2 about (0.70, 0.30)); fixed before any WL115 evidence; never used for selection, descriptors, calibration or training targets

stage_A.purpose: attribute the remaining full-depth spatial oracle error (WL114: R1L everywhere, innermost R4 rings, lifted 30-100 mm whole-near over-brightness) to resolution, reconstruction, projection measure or query-distribution mismatch, on SELECTION configurations only

constructions.C8: per unique SELECTION geometry (11): deep U-measure construction on an 8 x 8 grid of every patch (tracer115.construct_k, identical proposal sampling / pinned first vertex / deep probe to camera event 24 as WL114 construct_deep; n = 1,024 proposals per 8 x 8 cell and bin, b = 3, seeds 11510000 + 100 i); sums split by launch parity (two independent half tables). Nested: PC4 = exact sum-pooling of the same samples (4,096 per 4 x 4 cell).
constructions.CF: per unique SELECTION geometry: 32 x 32 deep U construction on the DIAGNOSTIC contact neighbourhood only (8 lowest-ring sphere patches + floor patches within 0.30 m of the support point; a ring-restricted diagnostic control, never a candidate support), n = 1,024, b = 8, seeds 11511000 + 100 i; pooled 16 x 16 nested

stage_A.capture: camera-conditioned (query-weighted) diagnostic projection: deep physical camera pass (4,096 spp, 512^2, to camera event 24, independent seeds 11512000 + 10 v) accumulating per event-2 cell the prefix throughput and the path's full-depth HIGH, at 8 x 8 on all patches and 32 x 32 on the contact neighbourhood. Views: F0 V0, F1 W0, F2 W0, F3 W0, SEQ_A gap 50 mm V0, SEQ_C gap 30 mm W0, SEQ_C gap 80 mm W0, SEQ_B x 0.70 V0. Camera-conditioned tables are diagnostic upper bounds only (they violate camera independence).

representations.PC4: piecewise-constant 4 x 4 U (nested, = the WL114 S4_F contract with 4x samples)
representations.BL4: bilinear reconstruction of the PC4 cell-centre values over each surface's global cell lattice (rect clamped, sphere periodic in phi / clamped at the poles), exact per-neighbour direction rebinning; uses ONLY the 4 x 4 information
representations.BL8: bilinear reconstruction of the PC8 values (8 x 8 information)
representations.R16 / R32: PC4 everywhere + 16 x 16 / 32 x 32 U on the diagnostic contact neighbourhood (ring-restricted diagnostic)
representations.R32on8: PC8 everywhere + 32 x 32 on the contact neighbourhood
representations.S4F_wl114: the WL114 S4_F table through the WL115 kernel (kernel / pairing authentication against WL114 hl|S4_F)
representations.capture views only: Q4 / Q8 (camera-conditioned 4 x 4 / 8 x 8, all patches), Q16R / Q32R (Q4 + camera-conditioned 16 x 16 / 32 x 32 on the contact neighbourhood), PC8_h0 / PC8_h1 and R32_h0 / R32_h1 (half-sample tables: table-noise estimate)

stage_A.streams: readout-only (tracer115.readout_multi) with the WL114 Stage B seeds of every SELECTION view (49 views x 2 streams, 4,096 spp, 512^2), paired with the WL114 deep physical references (LOW pairing checked against the WL114 readout)
stage_A.metrics: approved 3 % gate quantities at full depth (metrics113.gate3, unchanged): R1, R1L (5 x 5 windows, Bonferroni, failing count / max |e| / location by region floor < 0.5 m, sphere lower band, silhouette), R2, R3 bias, R4 rings, R5a/b bias; R5 RMSE non-regression control = PC4 (the dense 4 x 4 oracle); lifted-state (30-100 mm) near bias; table-noise contribution from the half tables
stage_A.attribution_reading: resolution = PC4 -> PC8 (nested, identical samples) and PC4 -> R16 / R32 (contact neighbourhood); reconstruction = PC -> BL at equal information; projection measure = U -> Q at equal resolution (capture views); localisation = R32 vs PC8 (is the residual confined to the contact neighbourhood); within-cell variation and event-2 query distribution from the capture (figures)

stage_B_selection_principle: Select ONE primary representation hypothesis from the Stage A evidence among: (C0) continuous reconstruction of the dense 4 x 4 values (no new information); (C1) per-cell higher-order / compact coefficient basis; (C2) geometry-determined adaptive / hierarchical refinement (support from geometry, material or transport state only; continuous activation; never the lowest sphere ring, camera visibility, contact ROI or reference residual); (C3) uniform finer grid. Prefer the lowest-runtime-cost class whose SELECTION oracle evidence shows a material reduction of the localisation errors (R1L failing windows and max |e|, innermost rings) and of the lifted-state over-brightness, not merely the mean near bias. The concrete candidate (basis, support rule, budget), its adequacy gate on HELD_SEEN + FRESH configurations, statistical rules, non-regression requirements and stop conditions are frozen in this file (stage_B_frozen) and committed BEFORE any HELD_SEEN or FRESH WL115 evidence stream. If no practical representation is supported by the oracle evidence, the learned path stops.
stop_conditions: physical construction materially unqualified (focused tests or address mismatch > 1e-4); remaining error not attributable to the proposed spatial mechanism; candidate oracle fails its frozen adequacy gate; impractical spatial budget; transport-ownership, source-independence / linearity or camera-independence violation; dynamic support not updatable; unacceptable collateral errors; a substantially different architecture hypothesis required
do_not: unlimited resolution increases, unlimited basis / interpolation searches, global capacity increase, SSS-specific contact corrections, clamping / masking, finite-depth cancellation, denoising, ER / SDM changes, LR3 training, gate relaxation, automatic adoption, the next milestone
